title: finding(tests): four hand-rolled comment strippers survive the objectui#9183 sweep under `packages/` — and one of them was written 39 hours AFTER it closed, with nothing in CI able to see that happen
body:
The objectui#9183 sweep moved 29 source-scanning carriers onto `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`. Four hand-rolled comment strippers are still in the tree, and **one of them was written after the sweep closed**. The load-bearing half of this finding is that second fact: ⛔ nothing in CI can see a new one appear.

## The four carriers, measured at `main`

| site | the stripper it hand-rolls |
|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082.test.ts:193` | `body.replace(/\/\*\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').replace(/^\s*\/\/.*$/gm, '')` |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/alert-dialog-read-dialect-7104.test.ts:219` | same two regexes |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts:266` | same two regexes |
| `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.parentIdNoCast-9333.test.ts:78` | `src.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' ')).replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g, '')` |

⚠️ **These are two different shapes and should not be reported as one.** The first three match `/**` only, so an ordinary `/* … */` block is invisible to them, and their line rule fires only at the start of a line. The fourth matches every block comment and **blanks rather than deletes** — it preserves byte offsets, which makes it a hand-rolled `maskComments`, not a hand-rolled `stripComments`. A fix that converts them has to pick the right projection per site, ⛔ not one of the two for all four.

## Residue versus recurrence — the split that makes this worth filing

- **Residue (3).** `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082` (first committed 2026-09-01), `alert-dialog-read-dialect-7104` (2026-09-05) and `overlay-trigger-union-7081` (2026-09-05) all predate objectui#9183, which closed **2026-09-13T00:25:07Z**. They are sites the sweep did not reach.
- ⭐ **Recurrence (1).** `LineItemsPanel.parentIdNoCast-9333.test.ts` was first committed **2026-09-14T15:01:29Z** — about **39 hours after the sweep closed**. A new hand-rolled stripper entered a swept tree and nothing reported it.

## Reachability — latent, and that is measured, not assumed

Two of the four were run against their own subjects and agree with the shared mask byte for byte today: `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082` over `packages/types/src/overlay.ts` (52,424 bytes) and `LineItemsPanel.parentIdNoCast-9333` over `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` (15,901 bytes). ⛔ **No damage is claimed.** The same was true of objectui#9613's site until a `testIgnore:` glob was written next to it; there, the two strippers agreed on the real file and diverged the moment a string literal spelled `/*`.

## Reproduction

`git grep -n '\[\\s\\S\]\*?' -- packages/` and read the hits that sit next to a `//` rule.

## What this is not

⛔ Not a request to widen `scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` with a baseline of known sites — that script's own header names a growing baseline as the wrong remedy for exactly this class. ⛔ And not the same finding as objectui#9613, which was one site inside `scripts/`; this is the population under `packages/` plus the recurrence channel.

## Provenance

Measured by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat while reviewing PR objectui#9748 (card objectui#9613), R72, 2026-09-18. The carrier list came from that pull request's dev; the residue/recurrence split, the two-shapes distinction and the dates were measured here before filing. ⛔ This seat does not grade, route or prioritise.

**Dedup words**: `naive comment stripper` · `js-comment-mask` · `9183 residue` · `recurrence after a sweep` · `hand-rolled maskComments`
